description: Search Arabic (or any) text with normalisation: tashkeel, alef/ya/ta-marbuta, hamza and Arabic-Indic digit variants are ignored, so فَاطِمَة matches فاطمة and ١٢٣ matches 123. mode=words (default) matches whole words, phrase matches any substring, fuzzy tolerates up to max_distance edits per word. Returns exact start/end offsets into the original text plus a context snippet.

context_chars.description: Characters of context on each side of a match.

max_distance.description: Edits allowed per word in fuzzy mode (default 1).

mode.description: words = whole-word phrase (default); phrase = any substring; fuzzy = edit-distance per word.

query.description: What to look for; normalised like the corpus.

name: text_search
title: Search text
